result.reason: The added operative insurance covenant satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfies the lower fallback limits. It correctly directs the duties to Garman and the certificate obligation to Sparkling. The redline preserves the operative text of the unrelated provisions and introduces no contradiction. It is not strictly minimal because it unnecessarily reorders the existing paragraphs from (j), (b), (i) to (b), (i), (j). Drafting quality is otherwise strong, though the cyber trigger uses a bespoke description of Sparkling-related data rather than the defined term “Customer Data.”
